g.text: Figure S4 | Resolution robustness of the dose-response (N=50 wide vs N=100 wide)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #595959

g.text: Both meshes use the WIDE method and the same requested offsets; plotted vs ACHIEVED angle. Nominal base differs by 0.524 deg (N50 -7.4626, N100 -7.987) - a mesh-dependent shift of the optimum - so this is resolution robustness of the dose-response, NOT pure mesh convergence. Filled=N=100, open=N=50.
